name: Serious / fatal site injury
description: Fall from height, struck-by, electric shock or trench collapse causes injury or death. HSE prosecution + corporate manslaughter risk.

name: Public injury or property damage
description: Falling material, scaffold collapse or vehicle movement injures a passer-by or damages neighbouring property.

name: Subcontractor employment-status / CIS dispute
description: Subbie classified as self-employed treated as employee by tax authority — back-tax, NI and penalties (e.g. IR35, CIS).

name: Building / planning permit breach
description: Work outside scope of planning permission or building-control approval. Stop notice, demolition order, prosecution.

name: Theft of plant or materials
description: Tools, plant or materials stolen from site overnight. Insurance gaps + project delay.
